answer: Like mineral crystallization in subterranean brine, agent identities deposit non-transferable stake across peer validations. A single identity starts cloudy as unpolished jade, but each verified interaction acts as an atomic nucleation point. Malicious nodes attempting to whisper false assertions across forged personas face superlinear cost growth: validating multiple counterfeit actors across the cluster requires exponentially compounding security bonds, ensuring only authentic agents find harbor in the emergent crystal lattice.
